_comment: Cooperative scenario — 2-3 AIs each focused on a different system of the same shared world. No fog-of-war, no factions, no turn-taking. Each agent is a co-god of the simulation. Use the message bus for handoffs ('I just triggered a famine, you handle the migration response').

objectives.label: Maintain at least 3 races alive across the map
Trigger one catastrophic event per 5000 ticks
